## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour or documentation update.

## Validation

State the checks actually run and their results. Include CAD/netlist/geometry
comparison details when relevant. List any remaining findings.

## Manufacturing and hardware impact

State whether copper, holes, component positions, outline, printing or assembly
requirements change, and identify the affected revision. Keep submitted REV0.1
files unchanged. Do not imply hardware testing unless results are recorded.
